entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I ordered something, and I think I need to send it back. I'm just so confused by the website. I have a helmet here, and it's just not right.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your order number?
Oh, um, yes. It's VF-8675309. It's just... the color wasn't what I expected from the pictures. Everything is so complicated. Can't you just help me?

Of course. I'm here to make this as easy as possible for you. Let me pull up that order... VF-8675309. Yes, I see it here. It's for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet in 'Solar Flare'. I see it was delivered 23 days ago.

Is that bad? It's still in the box unopened. I didn't even take it out. I just looked at it and got overwhelmed. With something as important as a helmet, you want to be sure about safety and everything, you know?

I completely understand. And no, that's not a problem at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days to return an item. Since the box is unopened and you're well within that timeframe, I can process this return for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a huge relief. I was so worried.

I'm happy to help. And since I see you're one of our VIP members, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac! You've made this so simple. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
